statement: For the fixed 18-vertex, 27-edge labelled graph G and lexicographic canonical convention frozen in source.md and problem.md, the family B_5(G)={F in binom(E(G),5): gamma(G-F)>gamma(G)=6} consists of exactly the 801 labelled five-edge sets serialized in evidence/bondage5_classification.json. Every such deletion has gamma(G-F)=7. Under the complete six-element group Aut(G), the family has exactly the 140 canonical orbits serialized in that file: 127 orbits have size 6 and setwise stabilizer order 1, and 13 have size 3 and setwise stabilizer order 2; each record gives the canonical representative and the complete stabilizer permutation list.
contribution: This is a complete exact computational classification in the full scope of the frozen problem, refining the cited paper's proof that b(G)=5. Two standard-library implementations independently exhaust all 80,730 deletion sets and independently enumerate the automorphism group; no broader literature-priority claim is asserted.
